newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: SIMEX Brent unquoted, market directionless.
newsitem.headline: SIMEX Brent unquoted, market directionless.

text.p: September Brent futures were not quoted at midday on Monday, with brokers' assessment of prices straddling London's close.
Brokers said bids for September Brent on SIMEX should come from around a range between $18.93 to $18.96 per barrel, after London ended one cent higher at $18.95.
October Brent on SIMEX was offered at $19.00, following London close of $18.97.
But brokers expected the market to be very thin with the lack of headline news, since the uncertainty over the timetable for Iraqi crude exports is now over.
NYMEX crude was last traded on ACCESS at $20.28, unchanged from New York, which had seen a 14 cent rise.
